subject: Chemistry
description: Composition of dry air, GHGs, noble gases, ozone vs ground ozone, common pollutants

questions.stem: Approximately what percentage of dry air (by volume) is nitrogen?
questions.explanation: Dry-air composition: N₂ ~78.09%, O₂ ~20.95%, Ar ~0.93%, CO₂ ~0.04% (~420 ppm in 2024, rising), Ne ~0.0018%, He ~0.0005%, CH₄ ~0.00019%. Water vapour varies 0-4% depending on humidity (excluded from 'dry' calculations). Composition is uniform up to ~80 km altitude — homosphere. Above 80 km, lighter gases (H, He) rise; heavier ones sink — heterosphere.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.stem: The MOST abundant noble gas in Earth's atmosphere is:
questions.explanation: Argon — 0.93% of atmosphere. Mostly Ar-40 produced by radioactive decay of K-40 over Earth's lifetime. Used in inert atmospheres (welding, incandescent bulbs to prevent filament oxidation), Geiger counters. Other noble gases: Ne ~18 ppm, He ~5 ppm (escapes Earth's gravity continuously — global helium reserves limited!), Kr ~1 ppm, Xe ~0.09 ppm, Rn (radioactive, trace, indoor air pollutant). Helium is more abundant in the universe (after H), but rare on Earth's atmosphere.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a greenhouse gas?
questions.explanation: Greenhouse gases — absorb infrared radiation re-emitted from Earth's surface. Major GHGs: H₂O vapour (largest, but mostly natural), CO₂ (longest impact), CH₄ (~30× CO₂'s GWP over 100 yr), N₂O (~270×), O₃ (tropospheric), CFCs/HFCs (1000s×). Diatomic molecules with the same atoms (N₂, O₂) — DON'T absorb IR — they have no dipole moment. So O₂ and N₂ are NOT GHGs. The Paris Agreement covers CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, HFCs, PFCs, SF₆, NF₃ ('Kyoto basket').

questions.stem: Atmospheric CO₂ concentration in 2024 was approximately:
questions.explanation: Mauna Loa observatory measurements (Keeling curve): CO₂ = 280 ppm pre-industrial → 315 in 1958 → 421 ppm (May 2024 monthly average). Highest in 800,000 years per Antarctic ice cores. Increasing ~2.5 ppm/year. Methane similarly: pre-industrial ~720 ppb → ~1,920 ppb in 2024. India's CO₂ emissions per capita are still low (~2 tCO₂/yr) vs USA (15) or China (8) — but total emissions are 3rd largest globally (~7% of total).

questions.stem: The gas responsible for ACID RAIN (along with NOₓ) is primarily:
questions.explanation: SO₂ — released by burning sulphur-rich coal, ore smelting, vehicle exhaust. In atmosphere SO₂ + O₂ + H₂O → H₂SO₃ → H₂SO₄. NOₓ → HNO₃. These dissolve in raindrops → 'acid rain' (pH < 5.6, sometimes <4). Damages forests, freshwater life (especially fish, amphibians), buildings (limestone CaCO₃ dissolves: Taj Mahal yellowing). Reduced sharply since 1990s in West with flue-gas desulphurisation in coal plants. Major SO₂ emitters today — India, China.

questions.stem: Carbon monoxide (CO) is highly toxic to humans because it:

options.option_text: Binds to haemoglobin ~250× more strongly than O₂, blocking oxygen transport

questions.explanation: CO + Hb → carboxyhaemoglobin (HbCO) — bond strength ~250× greater than HbO₂. Blocks the haemoglobin's oxygen-carrying capacity → cellular hypoxia → headache, dizziness, nausea, unconsciousness, death. Sources: incomplete combustion (vehicle exhaust without catalytic converter, faulty heaters, charcoal stoves indoors), forest fires, smoking. Antidote: 100% O₂ inhalation; hyperbaric O₂ in severe cases. CO is COLOURLESS, ODOURLESS, TASTELESS — silent killer. Domestic CO detectors save lives.

questions.stem: Among the noble gases, the one used in lasers and producing BRIGHT RED-ORANGE GLOW in 'neon signs' is:

options.option_text: Neon — gives the iconic red-orange light

questions.explanation: Each noble gas glows a characteristic colour when high voltage passed through low-pressure tube — Neon = bright red-orange (the only true 'neon' in 'neon signs'). Argon = pale lavender (with phosphor → bright white). Helium = orange-yellow. Krypton = dim greenish-white. Xenon = bright blue-white. Decorative 'neon signs' often use mixtures + coloured glass + phosphor coatings to produce other colours; only the genuine red-orange is from neon itself.
